_meta.purpose: Declarative recipe templates: motion transfer, object replacement, and the character reference batch. Slots are positional and typed; the served route's own catalogue entry decides which request parameter each slot fills.

_meta.slot_rules: A request lists slots in the template's declared order, starting at position 1. Each entry's type must equal the declared type. Required slots may not be omitted; optional slots may only be omitted from the end. A slot with an engine_role maps to the served route's catalogue input with that role; a route that has no such input, or fewer inputs than slots of that role, refuses the slot by name and never drops it.

generic_moderation.text: Provider moderation may refuse faces of real people without consent, and sexual or violent content. A refusal is the provider's decision; GenRight cannot predict it.

motion_transfer.title: Motion transfer: move a subject with the motion of a source video

slots.name: subject_image
slots.role: Identity image: the person or character who performs the motion.

slots.name: motion_video
slots.role: Motion source video: the movement to copy.

slots.name: identity_closeup
slots.role: Identity close-up of the face. Only served by a route that takes more than one reference image.

slots.name: outfit_image
slots.role: Outfit image. Only served by a route that takes more than one reference image.

prompt.lead: Animate the subject from the identity image with the motion of the source video.
prompt.lock: Keep the subject's face, hair, body, outfit and the background exactly as in the identity image. Transfer only the movement.

moderation.text: Moderation failures in this method come from wardrobe or audio. If a request is refused, change the flagged slot (the outfit image, or the audio of the motion video), not the whole prompt.

object_replacement.title: Object replacement: keep the whole source video, swap one targeted element

slots.name: source_video
slots.role: Source video kept as is except for the targeted element.

slots.name: replacement_item
slots.role: Replacement item: the image of the object that takes the targeted element's place.

slots.name: scene_image
slots.role: Scene image for lighting and setting context. Only served by a route that takes more than one reference image.

prompt.lead: Replace the targeted object in the source video with the replacement item.
prompt.lock: Keep everything else in the source video unchanged: the people, the camera motion, the timing, the lighting and the audio.

moderation.text: Moderation failures in this method come from wardrobe or audio. If a request is refused, change the flagged slot, not the whole prompt.

character_reference_batch.title: Character reference batch: one character, N scenario lines, one shared lock

lock_clauses.reference: Same character as the reference images: keep the face, hair, build and outfit identical.

review.compositing: Not implemented in this slice: the contact sheet is a list of the batch's items with a review state each, not a composited image.
